    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Arrow
    Represents an Arrow item in the game.
    Axe
    Represents an Axe item in the game.
    Backpack
    Represents the player's backpack grid.
    Bomb
    Represents a Bomb item in the game.
    BoundingBox
    Represents an axis-aligned bounding box defined by two corner points.
    Bow
    Represents a Bow item in the game.
    Chicken
    Represents a Chicken enemy in the game.
    ClickResult
    Represents the result of a click action in the game.
    ClickType
    Enum containing all type of click we can have when an event regarding the mouse is trigerred.
    Consequence
     
    Cookie
    Represents a Cookie item in the game.
    Crabe
    Class of a Crabe
    Curse
     
    DespairShield
    Represents a DespairShield item in the game.
    Direction
     
    Effect
     
    EnchantedDiamondSword
    Represents an EnchantedDiamondSword item in the game.
    Enemy
    Interface for enemies in the game.
    EnemyInfo
    Record containing all fixed informations about an ennemy
    EnemyRepository
    Repository class for all enemies and bosses in the game.
    EnemyRoom
    Represents a room containing enemies in the game.
    EventRoom
    Represents a room containing an event in the game.
    Exit
    Represents a room that serves as an exit in the game.
    FireBall
    Represents a FireBall item in the game.
    Floor
    Class representing a floor in the game.
    FontLoader
    Utility class for loading custom fonts from the "data/font" directory and calculating standardized font sizes based on the screen width.
    GameController
    The SimpleGameController class deals with the main game loop, including retrieving raw user actions, sending them for analysis to the GameView and GameData, and dealing with time events.
    GameData
    Stores all global data related to the current game session.
    GameDataClick
    Represents the click handling and drag-and-drop logic for the game's interface.
    GameDataCombat
    The game data with all methods for combat manipulation.
    GameDataHero
    The game data with all methods for hero manipulation.
    GameDataShop
    Represents the current state of the shop in the game.
    GameView
    The SimpleGameView class deals with the display of the game the screen, and with the interpretation of which zones were clicked on by the user.
    Gant
    Represents a Gant item in the game.
    Gnome
    Class of a Gnome
    Gold
    Represents a Gold item in the game.
    Hallway
    Represents a hallway in the floor grid.
    Healer
    Represents a Healer room in the floor.
    Hero
    Represents the player hero in the game.
    ImageLoader
     
    Item
    Represents an item that can be stored in the hero's backpack and used in combat.
    ItemRepository
    Repository for all items in the game.
    ItemStats
    Represents the immutable statistics of an item.
    KeyDoor
    Represents a KeyDoor item in the game.
    LinkedEvent
    Represents a sequence or chain of game events.
    LockedDoor
    Represents a Locked Door room in the floor.
    ManaStone
    Represents a ManaStone item in the game.
    Massue
    Represents a Massue item in the game.
    MathLoader
    The MathLoader class calculates and stores all the screen-dependent coordinates, sizes, and transformations needed to render game elements.
    Mimicry
    Represents a Mimicry item in the game.
    NodeEvent
    Represents a node in an event system or game logic.
    PoisonArrow
    Represents a PoisonArrow item in the game.
    RandomItem
    Utility class responsible for generating random items.
    Rarity
    Represents the rarity level of an item in the game.
    RenderData
    Represents rendering information for a graphical element.
    Robot
    Class of a Robot
    Room
    Interface for all types of rooms on a floor.
    Shield
    Represents a Shield item in the game.
    Shop
    Represents a Shop room in the floor.
    Soldat
    Class of a Soldat
    Start
    Represents the starting room of the floor.
    Sword
    Represents a Sword item in the game.
    Synergy
    Handles item synergies and calculates damage bonuses based on item combinations.
    Treasure
    Represents a treasure room that contains rewards for the hero.
    XY
    Represents a 2D coordinate in the game grid.
